name: Pistachio cake
assumptions: Yield estimated from standard 23cm springform layer cake with generous cream/fruit filling (typically 8-12 slices); conservatively set at 10.
Total time is approximate active + passive (mixing ~15 min, bake 35-40 min, cooling ~30-45 min to allow complete cooling before filling, cream chill 20-30 min); rounded to 90 min.
Butter classified as dairy and potential milk allergen source.
Mascarpone and double cream classified as dairy.
Pistachios (nuts and paste) classified as tree nuts allergen; peanuts left null as distinct.
Plain flour classified as wheat-containing; therefore not gluten-free.
No fish, shellfish, soy, or sesame ingredients listed or implied.
instructions:
Heat the oven to 180C/160C fan/gas 4. Butter and line a 23cm springform cake tin. Tip 150g of the pistachios into a food processor and blitz until finely ground. Tip into a bowl and mix in the flour, baking powder and pinch of salt. Beat the butter and sugar in a separate bowl until fluffy and pale, around 5 mins. Crack in the eggs one at a time, beating well for 1 min after each addition, until they have all been added. Beat in the vanilla, then fold in the flour mixture gently. Carefully spoon into the prepared tin and bake for 35-40 mins until a skewer inserted into the middle comes out clean. Set aside to cool completely on a wire rack in the tin.

step 2
Meanwhile, sift the icing sugar into a bowl, then tip in the mascarpone, double cream and pistachio paste. Beat until well combined, then set aside in the fridge for 20-30 mins to thicken to a spooning consistency.

step 3
Cut the cooled cake in half horizontally using a serrated knife, so you have two layers. Put the bottom layer on a plate or cake stand and spread over a generous spoonful of the pistachio cream. Top with a generous handful of the raspberries so the cake is covered. Top with the other sponge half, then cover the top and sides of the cake with the remaining cream. Scatter over the last of the raspberries, the remaining pistachios and the lime zest to serve. Will keep chilled in an airtight container for two days.

ingredients.name: Butter
ingredients.assumptions: Standard unsalted butter; used for both cake and tin greasing.

ingredients.name: Pistachio
ingredients.assumptions: Raw shelled pistachios; 150g ground in cake, remainder used as garnish.

ingredients.name: Baking Powder
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tsp baking powder; typical commercial amount and composition.

ingredients.name: Egg
ingredients.assumptions: 4 large eggs (approx 50 g edible portion each); beaten into batter.

ingredients.name: Vanilla Extract
ingredients.assumptions: 1 tsp vanilla extract; typical commercial strength.

ingredients.name: Double Cream
ingredients.assumptions: Heavy/double cream (approx 48% fat); 200 ml converted using density ~1 g/ml.

ingredients.name: Pistachio Paste
ingredients.assumptions: Commercial pistachio paste (nuts + sugar/oil); typical values for sweetened variety.

ingredients.name: Raspberries
ingredients.assumptions: Fresh whole raspberries; 300 g layered inside, remainder scattered on top.

ingredients.name: Unwaxed Lime
ingredients.assumptions: 1 medium unwaxed lime; only zest used (approx 5 g zest from 50 g whole fruit).
